title: Corregir atribución de heartbeat por job en frontier pressure
mission: Repair frontier-pressure liveness attribution so a worker heartbeat only refreshes ownership for the same durable job/opportunity. Preserve fail-closed behavior for heartbeats without attributable job identity, add deterministic regression coverage for cross-job reuse, and keep all authority pointers unchanged.
definition_of_done: buildSnapshotFromRepo indexes attributable heartbeats by worker plus job/opportunity identity rather than worker_id alone.
A recent heartbeat for job-B does not refresh an old retry-safe pin for job-A owned by the same worker; job-A becomes REPLACEABLE after the configured recovery window.
A recent heartbeat whose job_id matches the pin/claim still keeps that owner ACTIVE.
Equivalent cross-job coverage exists for opportunity claims.
Legacy or malformed heartbeats without a job identity fail closed and do not refresh unrelated ownership.
Existing frontier-pressure tests plus new regression tests pass under Node.
No Current, Human Accepted, Served or production /w pointer is changed.
